sources.title: Baidu frontend interview note containing the exact multiply-three-or-add-five prompt
Deterministic BFS and independent monotone-DAG DP oracle validation

claims.text: The repository source fixes start=1, allowed operations multiply by 3 or add 5, target=1024, and asks to find a solution; it does not explicitly require the shortest solution or a particular programming language.
The deterministic BFS reaches 1024 through 1,3,9,27,32,37,111,333,338,1014,1019,1024 in 11 operations, and an independent monotone-DAG DP oracle confirms 11 is the minimum operation count.

For positive targets, states above the target can be pruned because both allowed operations strictly increase positive integers; BFS reachability/distance agrees with the independent oracle for all targets 1..3000 in the fixture.
